> **A collection of $n$ triples (3-term APs from $\{1,\dots,n\}$, with repetition allowed) such that each value appears in exactly 3 triples.**

Each value gets 3 distinct colors (appears once per row), each column gets 3 distinct colors (one value per row). So each row is a permutation. ✓
